svg.aria-label: th3-skills: Claude Code skills that each do a whole job. 01 Design: screens, flows, banners, posts (design, social-media). 02 Build: prove the idea, run agents cheap (poc-spec-driven-builder, agent-kit). 03 Test: evidence, mock data, CVE reach (qa, thai-mock-naming, dependency-vuln-explainer). 04 Ship: infra, disk, docs, the sale (devops, containers, documentation, marketing). Install: /plugin install th3-skills --marketplace th3r-dev/th3-skills
